title: Cruise Port Shuttle
scenario: A port text says your shuttle time changed and asks for payment to confirm.

answers.A: Pay the confirmation fee through the text link.
answers.B: Check the change in your cruise booking or operator app.
answers.C: Ask the cruise desk or port staff using a known booking reference.
answers.D: Reply with the booking reference so they can confirm the change.

explanation: Port changes are plausible, which makes them useful for impersonation. Verify through the cruise operator before paying or sharing booking data.
proTip: A real schedule change should appear in the operator record.
